{{Youmay|the [[in-universe]] work|the [[The Pirate Prince (adventure)|roleplaying adventure]]}}
'''''The Pirate Prince''''' was a work by the [[Lisst'n]] dramatist [[Lyechusas]] detailing the conquests of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot. While the original manuscripts were lost, extracts from the work survived in the [[Oor]] manuscripts.
